testcase.system-out: Scenario: Collapse and reopens the part origin branch during sketch editing ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And Sketch1 is being edited ✔ And the model browser shows an expanded Origin branch and other document entries ✔ When the user selects the expansion control beside Origin ✔ Then the Origin branch collapses and its child entries are hidden ✔ And the other document entries remain visible in the browser ✔ And the sketch remains displayed in the viewport ✔ When the user selects the expansion control beside Origin again ✔ Then the Origin branch expands and its child entries are displayed ✔ And the other document entries remain visible ✔ And the sketch remains displayed in the viewport
